note: Blind-rater targets, RE-RATED under the amended doctrine (a recall ceiling is not a defect; a precision string is judged on how exhaustively it covers the concept it targets). 52 in-role strings, two independent raters, shuffled anonymized input, no access to the scorer. Merged by the implementer from blind_ratings_fable_v2.json and blind_ratings_opus_v2.json because the named merged file was absent; the superseded first rating is kept as rater_targets_v1.json.
